verdict.rationale: Fathom is a SaaS meeting-recorder with a public REST API, SDKs, webhooks and OAuth apps, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the pack documents a sandbox, test mode, test API keys or mock data. API keys are generated in User Settings and read real meetings recorded by the user or shared to their team.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
